items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So then I spoke to Pops McElroy and told him that my friend from Oklahoma was down

ctx.x: to see that you get in the dance, so you bring them on down.

So then I spoke to Pops McElroy and told him that my friend from Oklahoma was down and he wanted to bring a party in, I said I don't know how many they are. Pops McElroy said bring in whoever you want.
